newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL, Soproni, Domus, Zwack push BUX index higher.
newsitem.headline: MOL, Soproni, Domus, Zwack push BUX index higher.

text.p: Oil and gas company MOL Rt was the most traded on the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) on a relatively quiet day, traders said.
MOL rose 35 forints to end at 1,790 and gave one third of the total spot turnover but many were prepared to sell at this price.
"There was only one buyer (for MOL) and the large number of sellers suggests they do not share the buyer's confidence in the paper's potential," said Andrea Keresztesi of ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett.
Retailer Domus produced the highest percentage gain ending at 355 forints, up 25, but its turnover was insignificant. Two other large gainers, Zwack and brewery Soproni also saw only modest trade.
"Most liquid shares were little changed," said Keresztesi.

She added that as the recent stars of the BSE such as MOL, the pharmaceutical companies, and the chemicals makers are seen peaking, the market is turning its attention to papers that have lost enough lately to become attractive again.
"This is the case of (tile maker) Zalakeramia, which has dropped to a level where it could be interesting," she said.
